title: 'प्रिय मौनता' कवितासङ्ग्रहमा प्रयुक्त अन्तर्पाठीयताको विश्लेषण
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कवि नेत्र एटमको 'प्रिय मौनता' (२०७७) कवितासङ्ग्रहमा प्रयोग भएको अन्तर्पाठीयताको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यस कवितासङ्ग्रहका कविताहरुमा प्रयोग भएका बाह्य पाठले कवितामा ल्याएका सघनता र विशिष्टताको खोजी गर्नु प्रस्तुत लेखको उद्देश्य हो । यस सन्दर्भमा कविताहरूको विश्लेषणका लागि उत्तरआधुनिक चिन्तन अन्तर्पाठीयतालाई सैद्धान्तिक ढाँचाका रूपमा उपयोग गरिएको छ । अन्तपठीयताको अवधारणाले सबै साहित्यको रचना अन्य कुनै पाठको सहयोग र सहायता लिएर सिर्जित भएको हुन्छ भन्ने मान्यता राख्दछ । यस सङ्ग्रहका कविताहरुमा मानवीय जीवन र प्रेमका शाश्वत अनुभूतिका साथै मनका विभिन्न अवस्था र स्थितिलाई प्रकृति र पर्यावरणका विभिन्न सरल र सुन्दर बिम्बमार्फत सघन अभिव्यक्ति गरिएको छ । यहाँ सरल र सामान्य लाग्ने शब्दहरूमा अनुभूतिको तीव्रता र भावको सघनता भर्न नेपाली साहित्य र पाश्चात्य जगत्का विभिन्न सिर्जनाहरूमा प्रयोग भएका विषय, अनुभूति, विचार, शैली र चिन्तनलाई संशोधित परिवर्धित र परिमार्जित गरी उपयोग गरिएको छ । यी कवितामा आत्मिक प्रेमका साथै मानवीय अस्तित्व, स्वाभिमान र स्वतन्त्रताका शाश्वत र उदात्त भावलाई जादुमयी र प्रवाहमयी तुल्याउन अग्रज लेखक, पात्र र चिन्तनसँग गहन अन्तर्क्रिया र रचनात्मक तर्क गर्नाका साथै तिनीहरूका विषय, विचार, भाव र शैलीको रचनात्मक, सिर्जनशील र मौलिक अनुसरण गरिएको छ । यस लेखमा कवितामार्फत विश्वसाहित्यका पूर्वजहरूसँग गरिएको संवादका साथै विचार, भाव र शैलीको परिष्कृत र परिमार्जित अनुसरणले सङ्गृहीत कवितालाई सरल आवरणमा गहन, विशिष्ट र शक्तिशाली तुल्याएका छन् ।
american_english: In the present article, the intertextuality used in the poetry collection 'Priya Maunata' (2077) by poet Netra Atom has been analyzed. Searching for the density and distinctiveness brought into the poems by the external texts used in the poems of this poetry collection is the objective of the present article. In this context, postmodern thought intertextuality has been used as a theoretical framework for the analysis of the poems. The concept of intertextuality holds the belief that the creation of all literature takes place with the help and assistance of some other text. In the poems of this collection, along with the eternal feelings of human life and love, the various states and conditions of the mind have been densely expressed through various simple and beautiful images of nature and environment. Here, to fill the intensity of feeling and the density of emotion into words that seem simple and ordinary, the themes, feelings, thoughts, style and thinking used in various creations of Nepali literature and the Western world have been used after being revised, expanded and refined. In these poems, along with spiritual love, to make the eternal and sublime feelings of human existence, self-respect and freedom magical and flowing, deep interaction and creative argument have been carried out with senior writers, characters and thought, and their themes, thoughts, feelings and style have been creatively, innovatively and originally followed. In this article, along with the dialogue held with the predecessors of world literature through the poems, the refined and improved following of thought, feeling and style has made the collected poems deep, distinctive and powerful beneath a simple veneer.

informal_english: This article analyses the intertextuality in poet Netra Atom's collection 'Priya Maunata' (2077). The whole point is to track down the density and distinctiveness the outside texts bring to the poems in the collection. For that, postmodern intertextuality was used as the theoretical framework for analysing the poems. The idea behind intertextuality is that every piece of literature is created with help from some other text. In these poems, alongside the timeless feelings of human life and love, the mind's varied states and moods get densely expressed through simple, beautiful images drawn from nature and the environment. To pack intensity of feeling and emotional density into words that seem plain and ordinary, themes, feelings, thoughts, style and thinking from Nepali literature and Western writing have been borrowed and reworked. Alongside spiritual love, to make the eternal, sublime feelings of human existence, self-respect and freedom magical and flowing, the poems deeply engage and creatively argue with senior writers, characters and thought, and creatively, innovatively and originally follow their themes, thoughts, feelings and style. In this article, the dialogue with the forebears of world literature through the poems, together with the refined and improved following of thought, feeling and style, has made the collected poems deep, distinctive and powerful under a simple surface.
translator_notes: Strict eight-sentence order preserved; 'Netra Atom' transliterated as in source; intertextuality rendered for अन्तर्पाठीयता.
